name: Repotrectinib
mechanism: Compact macrocyclic ATP-competitive inhibitor designed to avoid steric clash with solvent-front mutations, retaining activity against ROS1 G2032R and TRK solvent-front mutants, with CNS penetration.
interactions: Avoid strong CYP3A and P-gp inhibitors and strong CYP3A inducers. May reduce efficacy of hormonal contraceptives.
resistance: Mechanisms are still being characterised; include additional kinase-domain mutations and MAPK bypass activation.
